dismissalText.commentary: Sediqullah Atal c †Marumani b Masekesa 17 (21b 2x4 0x6 35m) SR: 80.95

dismissalComment.html: first wicket for Masekesa! And Atal is walking back even before the TV umpire's response. This was a flatter, good length ball outside off, and the googly turns further away. Atal came down the track to hammer a shot down the ground but missed it altogether. He tried to bring the bat down in time but the keeper had already whipped the bails off by then. BTW, it has been given out as a caught-behind dismissal, Atal appears to have got an edge too. That's why he was walking before the replay

dismissalComment.html: keeper appeals, bowler follows, and the umpire raises his finger! Matigimu is on a hat-trick. Kamal has a duck too. dismissalText.commentary: Azmatullah Omarzai c Evans b Sikandar Raza 116 (50b 5x4 12x6 75m) SR: 232

dismissalComment.html: backs away to launch this one out of the ground but ends up holing out to the long off fielder. Tossed up outside off. The change of pace finally works for Raza and Zimbabwe. Raza and Rashid congratulate Omarzai and he gets a standing ovation from the dugout as he walks back. One for the ages!

dismissalText.commentary: Sediqullah Atal c †Marumani b Masekesa 17 (21b 2x4 0x6 35m) SR: 80.95

dismissalComment.html: first wicket for Masekesa! And Atal is walking back even before the TV umpire's response. This was a flatter, good length ball outside off, and the googly turns further away. Atal came down the track to hammer a shot down the ground but missed it altogether. He tried to bring the bat down in time but the keeper had already whipped the bails off by then. BTW, it has been given out as a caught-behind dismissal, Atal appears to have got an edge too. That's why he was walking before the replay
